text: Mikhail Petrov, Senior SRE/DevOps Engineer at NexaGame Studios, has spent seven years shaping resilient infrastructure for the gaming industry. His work centers on AWS, where he designed scalable architectures that supported global player traffic, mentored junior engineers, and streamlined cross-team workflows. CI/CD pipelines under his stewardship reduced deployment friction by 40%, while Kubernetes deployments achieved 99.95% uptime during peak gaming events. Terraform and Prometheus/Grafana became foundational tools for automating infrastructure and real-time monitoring, respectively. Load balancing strategies he pioneered slashed latency by 30% across core game services, ensuring seamless multiplayer experiences. GCP integration delivered critical redundancy for mission-critical systems, with measurable improvements in disaster recovery times. Chaos engineering is embedded in daily operations, with proactive stress tests preventing outages during major updates. While Docker and ELK stack are used for containerization and log aggregation, PostgreSQL and Python handle backend automation and data workflows. His focus on reliability and scalability has positioned him as a key architect for NexaGame’s next-gen infrastructure.
